limits: No second 620-tile emission replay in this bounded review; literal-emission origin is supported by reviewed strict historical exporter and its retained source receipts.
All 3D, full-body, headroom, source-node co-elevation, final changed-tile inventory, cache/reuse/worker and native final-model acceptance gates remain open.
Future derived fragments must carry explicit immutable parent raw arcs; never strip stadium suffixes or interpolate across the removed source interval.
The exporter arc() nearest monotonic projection is not a general loop-ambiguity proof. This reviewed ROI contains none of its 13 derived fragment IDs.

Generic unionPhysicalRoads does not currently gate contextNotRendered; this artifact explicitly has zero. A future artifact must be validated with the stronger context coverage check before solver use.
The current cross-road finite oracle skips identical road IDs. A separate own-source local-fold/remote-self-crossing headroom gate is required before final geometry acceptance.
